slots.title: Slot machine
slots.description: Three reels, five lines (three rows, two diagonals). A line pays its symbol's prize × the line bet (the spin's cost ÷ 5 × the bet). At the default it pays back about 96%.

cost.description: DleCoins a spin at bet ×1 (all five lines)

bets.description: The bets on offer (×1, ×5…): cost and prizes both multiplied

luck.description: The luck levels on offer, the first the plain machine. Luck: on each of reels 2 and 3, with chance nudge, a symbol lines up with the reel before it on a random line (wins come more often, big ones much more). It costs the spin × cost; prizes stay. Simulated: nudge 0.25 pays back about 1.77× the plain machine, 0.5 about 2.97× — keep cost at or above that, or the machine pays out more than it takes

dailySpins.description: Spins a day (a bigger bet still counts as one)

symbols.description: Each symbol: how often it comes up (weight) and what a line of three pays (× the line bet); two counts two from the left

pachinko.title: Pachinko
pachinko.description: A ball bounces down the pegs (one row fewer than pockets) into a pocket, which pays its coins. At the default it pays back about 95%, and the meter adds a free capsule.

pockets.description: What each pocket pays, left to right (the middle ones are the likeliest)

meter.description: DleCoins played to fill the meter: a free capsule each time

freeBalls.description: Free balls each time the meter fills (they don't fill the meter, earn tokens or count against the day's balls)

capsules.title: Capsule machine
capsules.description: Turn the knob for a capsule with an icon frame inside

odds.description: How often each rarity comes out (weights)

duplicate.description: DleCoins back for a frame already owned, by rarity

cardShop.title: Daily Card Shop
cardShop.description: Every DleCoin paid into the machines (slots, pachinko, capsules, roulette) earns casino tokens, the only currency of the Daily Card Shop: a few cards a day, the same for everyone, each bought once a day.

coinsPerToken.description: DleCoins paid into the casino for one token

prices.description: Tokens a card costs, by rarity

slots.description: Cards on the shelf each day, by rarity (a mythic joins them on special occasions)

luckyDayChance.description: Chance a day is a lucky day (a mythic on the shelf), besides the fixed occasions

scratch.title: Scratch cards
scratch.description: A few scratch cards a day. Unlike the machines they pay back more than they cost on average (about x1.2), a reward for players who farmed the DleCoins. Three of the same prize in the 3x3 grid win it.

perDay.description: Cards of this kind a player can buy each day

prizes.description: [prize in DleCoins, weight]: 0 is no win. Needs at least 5 prizes above 0 to fill a losing grid.

claw.title: Claw machine
claw.description: The claw machine, paid in casino tokens (a reward for playing the other machines). Its box holds plushies and other prizes, a new mix every day; a grab holds better the closer the claw is to a prize's centre, and every miss fills a meter towards a grab that can't slip.

bundle.description: Several tries at once, for less

dailyTries.description: Tries a player can play each day

meter.description: Failed tries before a sure grab

boxSize.description: Prizes in the box when it's full

restockBelow.description: The box is filled up again when it holds fewer prizes than this

reach.description: How far from a prize's centre the claw can still catch it (the box is 1 wide)

slip.description: Chance a badly-aimed prize slips on the way to the chute (less the better the aim)

grip.description: How well each kind of prize holds in the claw (1: always, if well aimed)
